canDoYue: 你識量碼，仲識請人試戴。
canDoEn: Offer a try-on, measure a finger, and say if it is tight or loose.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Would you like to try this ring on, and see it in the mirror?
dialogue.glossYue: 想唔想試吓呢隻戒指，再照吓鏡？
dialogue.say: Would you like to try this ring on, and see it in the mirror?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can you measure my finger, and tell me the size?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以量吓我隻手指，話我知碼數？
dialogue.say: Can you measure my finger, and tell me the size?

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: This size is a little tight, and it pinches when I close my hand.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢個碼有啲緊，我握拳會夾。
dialogue.say: This size is a little tight, and it pinches when I close my hand.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: It feels almost right, but I would like it a little looser.
dialogue.glossYue: 差唔多啱，不過我想鬆少少。
dialogue.say: It feels almost right, but I would like it a little looser.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: I can adjust it. Look in the mirror and tell me how it sits.
dialogue.glossYue: 我可以改。你照吓鏡，話我知戴得點。
dialogue.say: I can adjust it. Look in the mirror and tell me how it sits.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: It feels a little loose on this finger now.
dialogue.say: It feels a little loose on this finger now.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: How does it feel when you wear it for a moment?
dialogue.say: How does it feel when you wear it for a moment?

understand.prompt: Would you like to try this ring on? 係？
understand.explain: try on 係試戴。等客人答完先動手。

understand.prompt: This size is a little tight. 隻戒指？
understand.explain: tight 係緊。鬆先至係 loose。

understand.prompt: Look in the mirror. 你想客人？

chunks.pattern: Would you like to try this ___ on before you decide today?
chunks.example: Would you like to try this ring on before you decide today?

chunks.pattern: Can you measure my ___ so we can find a comfortable size?
chunks.example: Can you measure my finger so we can find a comfortable size?

chunks.pattern: This size is a little ___ when I close my hand.
chunks.example: This size is a little tight when I close my hand.

chunks.pattern: Please look in the ___ and tell me how the piece sits.
chunks.example: Please look in the mirror and tell me how the piece sits.

build.promptYue: Tom 話個碼有啲緊。你點接？
choices: The total is a good deal.
build.explain: 太緊可以改碼。呢輪用 adjust，唔用 resize。

roleplay.intro: Tom 想試戒指。等佢講完先答。問吓手感：How does it feel?

quiz.explain: loose 開頭係 /l/。tight 係 /t/。fit 係短 /ɪ/。

sound.title: 鬆，唔係失去
sound.note: loose 開頭係 /l/。舌尖抵住上顎後面，氣由兩邊出，尾音 /s/。tight 係太緊。fit 係啱唔啱。lose 先至係失去，呢課唔教。
